verses.original: וְעַתָּ֤ה׀ שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם־ כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śā·ḥă·qū ‘ā·lay ṣə·‘î·rîm mim·men·nî lə·yā·mîm ’ă·šer- mā·’as·tî ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·šîṯ ‘im- kal·ḇê ṣō·nî
verses.literal: But now they mock me . . . men younger than I am . . . whose fathers I would have refused to put with my sheep dogs
verses.literalPt: AGORA, porém, se riem de mim os de menos idade do que eu, cujos pais eu teria desdenhado de pôr com os cães do meu rebanho.

verses.original: גַּם־ כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח׃
verses.transliteration: gam- kō·aḥ yə·ḏê·hem lām·māh lî ‘ā·lê·mōw ’ā·ḇaḏ kā·laḥ
verses.literal: What use to me . . . was the strength of their hands since their vigor had left them
verses.literalPt: De que também me serviria a força das mãos daqueles, cujo vigor se tinha esgotado?

verses.original: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥe·ser ū·ḇə·ḵā·p̄ān gal·mūḏ ha·‘ō·rə·qîm ṣî·yāh ’e·meš šō·w·’āh ū·mə·šō·’āh
verses.literal: Gaunt from poverty and hunger they gnawed the dry land and the desolate wasteland by night
verses.literalPt: De míngua e fome se debilitaram; e recolhiam-se para os lugares secos, tenebrosos, assolados e desertos.

verses.original: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי־ שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qō·ṭə·p̄îm mal·lū·aḥ ‘ă·lê- śî·aḥ wə·šō·reš rə·ṯā·mîm laḥ·mām
verses.literal: They plucked mallow among the shrubs and the roots of the broom tree were their food
verses.literalPt: Apanhavam malvas junto aos arbustos, e o seu mantimento eram as raízes dos zimbros.

verses.original: מִן־ גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: min- gêw yə·ḡō·rā·šū yā·rî·‘ū ‘ā·lê·mōw kag·gan·nāḇ
verses.literal: They were banished from among men shouted at like thieves
verses.literalPt: Do meio dos homens eram expulsos, e gritavam contra eles, como contra o ladrão;

verses.original: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·rūṣ nə·ḥā·lîm liš·kōn ḥō·rê ‘ā·p̄ār wə·ḵê·p̄îm
verses.literal: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis among the rocks and in holes in the ground
verses.literalPt: Para habitarem nos barrancos dos vales, e nas cavernas da terra e das rochas.

verses.original: בֵּין־ שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bên- śî·ḥîm yin·hā·qū ta·ḥaṯ ḥā·rūl yə·sup·pā·ḥū
verses.literal: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles
verses.literalPt: Bramavam entre os arbustos, e ajuntavam-se debaixo das urtigas.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־ נָ֭בָל גַּם־ בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי־ שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- nā·ḇāl gam- bə·nê ḇə·lî- šêm nik·kə·’ū min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: A senseless and nameless brood they were driven off the land
verses.literalPt: Eram filhos de doidos, e filhos de gente sem nome, e da terra foram expulsos.

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nə·ḡî·nā·ṯām hā·yî·ṯî wā·’ĕ·hî lā·hem lə·mil·lāh
verses.literal: And now they mock me in song I have become a byword among them
verses.literalPt: Agora, porém, sou a sua canção, e lhes sirvo de provérbio.

verses.original: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא־ חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ti·‘ă·ḇū·nî rā·ḥă·qū men·nî ū·mip·pā·nay lō- ḥā·śə·ḵū rōq
verses.literal: They abhor me and keep far from me they do not hesitate to spit in my face
verses.literalPt: Abominam-me, e fogem para longe de mim, e no meu rosto não se privam de cuspir.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִתְרוֹ פִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiṯ·rō p̄it·taḥ way·‘an·nê·nî wə·re·sen mip·pā·nay šil·lê·ḥū
verses.literal: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me they have cast off restraint in my presence
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus desatou a sua corda, e me oprimiu, por isso sacudiram de si o freio perante o meu rosto.

verses.original: עַל־ יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- yā·mîn pir·ḥaḥ yā·qū·mū raḡ·lay šil·lê·ḥū way·yā·sōl·lū ‘ā·lay ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ ’ê·ḏām
verses.literal: The rabble arises at my right they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps . . . against me
verses.literalPt: À direita se levantam os moços; empurram os meus pés, e preparam contra mim os seus caminhos de destruição.

verses.original: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯə·sū nə·ṯî·ḇā·ṯî lə·haw·wā·ṯî yō·‘î·lū lō ‘ō·zêr lā·mōw
verses.literal: They tear up my path they profit from my destruction with no one to restrain them
verses.literalPt: Desbaratam-me o caminho; promovem a minha miséria; contra eles não há ajudador.

verses.original: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·p̄e·reṣ rā·ḥāḇ ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yū ta·ḥaṯ šō·ʾāh hiṯ·gal·gā·lū
verses.literal: They advance as through a wide breach through the ruins they keep rolling in
verses.literalPt: Vêm contra mim como por uma grande brecha, e revolvem-se entre a assolação.

verses.original: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·hə·paḵ ‘ā·lay bal·lā·hō·wṯ tir·dōp̄ kā·rū·aḥ nə·ḏi·ḇā·ṯî ū·ḵə·‘āḇ ‘ā·ḇə·rāh yə·šu·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Terrors are turned loose against me they drive away my dignity as by the wind and my prosperity has passed like a cloud
verses.literalPt: Sobrevieram-me pavores; como vento perseguem a minha honra, e como nuvem passou a minha felicidade.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ‘ā·lay tiš·tap·pêḵ nap̄·šî yō·ḥă·zū·nî yə·mê- ‘ō·nî
verses.literal: And now my soul is poured out within me days of affliction grip me
verses.literalPt: E agora derrama-se em mim a minha alma; os dias da aflição se apoderaram de mim.

verses.original: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: lay·lāh ‘ă·ṣā·may niq·qar mê·‘ā·lāy wə·‘ō·rə·qay lō yiš·kā·ḇūn
verses.literal: Night pierces . . . my bones and my gnawing pains never rest
verses.literalPt: De noite se me traspassam os meus ossos, e os meus nervos não descansam.

verses.original: בְּרָב־ כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rāḇ- kō·aḥ yiṯ·ḥap·pêś lə·ḇū·šî kə·p̄î ḵut·tā·nə·tî ya·’az·rê·nî
verses.literal: With great force He grasps my garment He seizes me by the collar of my tunic
verses.literalPt: Pela grandeza do meu mal está desfigurada a minha veste, que, como a gola da minha túnica, me cinge.

verses.original: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·rā·nî la·ḥō·mer wā·’eṯ·maš·šêl ke·‘ā·p̄ār wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: He throws me into the mud and I have become like dust and ashes
verses.literalPt: Lançou-me na lama, e fiquei semelhante ao pó e à cinza.

verses.original: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šaw·wa‘ ’ê·le·ḵā wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·nê·nî ‘ā·maḏ·tî wat·tiṯ·bō·nen bî
verses.literal: I cry out to You for help but You do not answer when I stand up You merely look at me
verses.literalPt: Clamo a ti, porém, tu não me respondes; estou em pé, porém, para mim não atentas.

verses.original: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: tê·hā·p̄êḵ lə·’aḵ·zār lî bə·‘ō·ṣem yā·ḏə·ḵā ṯiś·ṭə·mê·nî
verses.literal: You have ruthlessly turned on me You oppose me with Your strong hand
verses.literalPt: Tornaste-te cruel contra mim; com a força da tua mão resistes violentamente.

verses.original: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תְּשֻׁוֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: tiś·śā·’ê·nî ’el- rū·aḥ tar·kî·ḇê·nî ū·ṯə·mō·ḡə·ḡê·nî tə·šuw·wɛh
verses.literal: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it You toss me about in the storm
verses.literalPt: Levantas-me sobre o vento, fazes-me cavalgar sobre ele, e derretes-me o ser.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל־ חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·ḏa‘·tî mā·weṯ tə·šî·ḇê·nî ū·ḇêṯ mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḵāl ḥāy
verses.literal: Yes I know that You will bring me down to death to the place appointed for all the living
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sei que me levarás à morte e à casa do ajuntamento determinada a todos os viventes.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹא־ בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח־ יָ֑ד אִם־ בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō- ḇə·‘î yiš·laḥ- yāḏ ’im- bə·p̄î·ḏōw lā·hen šū·a‘
verses.literal: Yet no one stretches out his hand against a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém não estenderá a mão para o túmulo, ainda que eles clamem na sua destruição.

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה־ י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ḇā·ḵî·ṯî liq·šêh- yō·wm ‘ā·ḡə·māh nap̄·šî lā·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: Have I not wept for those in trouble . . . Has my soul not grieved for the needy
verses.literalPt: Porventura não chorei sobre aquele que estava aflito, ou não se angustiou a minha alma pelo necessitado?

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṭō·wḇ qiw·wî·ṯî way·yā·ḇō rā‘ wa·’ă·ya·ḥă·lāh lə·’ō·wr way·yā·ḇō ’ō·p̄el
verses.literal: But when I hoped for good evil came when I looked for light darkness fell
verses.literalPt: Todavia aguardando eu o bem, então me veio o mal, esperando eu a luz, veio a escuridão.

verses.original: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא־ דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי־ עֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ay rut·tə·ḥū wə·lō- ḏām·mū qid·də·mu·nî yə·mê- ‘ō·nî
verses.literal: I am churning within and cannot rest days of affliction confront me
verses.literalPt: As minhas entranhas fervem e não estão quietas; os dias da aflição me surpreendem.

verses.original: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·ḏêr hil·laḵ·tî bə·lō ḥam·māh qam·tî ḇaq·qā·hāl ’ă·šaw·wê·a‘
verses.literal: I go about blackened but not by the sun I stand up in the assembly and cry for help
verses.literalPt: Denegrido ando, porém não do sol; levantando-me na congregação, clamo por socorro.

verses.original: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’āḥ hā·yî·ṯî lə·ṯan·nîm wə·rê·a‘ liḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: I have become a brother of jackals a companion of ostriches
verses.literalPt: Irmão me fiz dos chacais, e companheiro dos avestruzes.

verses.original: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי־ חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי־ חֹֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·rî šā·ḥar mê·‘ā·lāy wə·‘aṣ·mî- ḥā·rāh min·nî- ḥō·reḇ
verses.literal: My skin grows black and peels . . . and my bones burn with fever
verses.literalPt: Enegreceu-se a minha pele sobre mim, e os meus ossos estão queimados do calor.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lə·’ê·ḇel kin·nō·rî wə·‘u·ḡā·ḇî lə·qō·wl bō·ḵîm
verses.literal: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping
verses.literalPt: A minha harpa se tornou em luto, e o meu órgão em voz dos que choram.
